title: A Detailed Look at the 2002 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 94
description: Explore the 2002 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 94, a luxurious Italian masterpiece blending high performance, upgraded amenities, and exquisite design.
html:
The 2002 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 94 is a testament to the craftsmanship and engineering prowess of the renowned Italian shipyard, Ferretti Yachts. This vessel has been meticulously maintained and upgraded over the years, ensuring it remains a top choice for those seeking a reliable and well-appointed yacht. With its blend of performance, comfort, and modern amenities, the Ferretti Custom Line 94 is a standout in its class.

Overview of the 2002 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 94

The Ferretti Custom Line 94 measures 94 feet in length and boasts a beam of 23.25 feet, providing ample space for both relaxation and entertainment. Built in 2002, this yacht has undergone significant upgrades, including a full exterior paint job and interior refit. The yacht’s design combines functionality with a sleek aesthetic, offering a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces. With a maximum draft of 5.67 feet, it is well-suited for a variety of cruising environments.

Engine and Performance Specifications

Powered by twin MTU 12VM96L engines, each delivering 1920 horsepower, the Ferretti Custom Line 94 offers a cruising speed of 20 knots and can reach a maximum speed of 23 knots. The engines were installed in 2017 and have been maintained with utmost care, currently showing only 1800 hours of use. The yacht’s fuel capacity of 3000 gallons ensures extended cruising capability, while the 750-gallon freshwater tank supports prolonged stays at sea.

Luxurious Interior Design and Amenities

The interior of the Ferretti Custom Line 94 has been thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and convenience. The salon features newly upholstered leather sofas, a Samsung Smart TV, and a full-service wet bar. The galley is equipped with modern appliances, including a Bosch stove and dishwasher, and offers ample storage space. Accommodations include a master cabin with ensuite facilities, a VIP stateroom, and two guest cabins, each with private bathrooms. The yacht also includes crew quarters with updated amenities.

Advanced Navigation and Helm Features

The helm station has been upgraded with a comprehensive Garmin navigation package, including autopilot, radar, and VHF communication systems. The bridge is equipped with a range of controls and gauges to ensure precise handling and navigation. Features such as the Wesmar fin stabilization controls and the QUICK anchoring system enhance the yacht’s operational capabilities, providing a smooth and stable ride.

Exterior Upgrades and Deck Equipment

The exterior of the Ferretti Custom Line 94 has been enhanced with a custom fiberglass hardtop and new exterior cushion upholstery. The flybridge includes a Jacuzzi, sunbathing area, and updated navigation instruments. The aft deck offers alfresco dining for up to ten guests, while the hydraulic platform and swim steps facilitate easy water access. Additional features include oversized windlass anchoring systems and recessed LED lighting for nighttime ambiance.

Summary and Key Highlights of the Yacht

The 2002 Ferretti Yachts Custom Line 94 is a well-maintained yacht that combines performance with modern amenities. Its recent upgrades ensure it remains competitive in the market, offering a comfortable and enjoyable experience for its owners and guests. With its spacious layout, advanced navigation systems, and thoughtful design, this yacht is an excellent choice for those seeking a reliable vessel for extended cruising.
